supplements.title: The impact of dietary constituents on inflammation and cognitive function in healthy older Irish adults: A pilot study.
supplements.summary: In healthy older adults, higher BMI, low physical activity, and nutrient deficiencies were associated with increased inflammation and decreased cognitive performance.

supplements.title: Metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease and type 2 diabetes: Pathophysiology, diagnosis, and emerging therapeutic strategies.
supplements.summary: In patients with type 2 diabetes, emerging pharmacotherapies like GLP-1 receptor agonists show promise in treating metabolic liver disease and reducing related health risks.

supplements.title: Integrated hepatic transcriptome and metabolome reveal the mechanisms of Jiangtang Tiaozhi formula on improving glycolipid metabolic disorder.
supplements.summary: Glycolipid metabolic disorder includes a series of chronic diseases that are closely associated with disturbances in both glucose and lipid metabolism.

supplements.title: Taurine suppresses gastric intestinal metaplasia in patient-derived organoids and Atp4a -/- mice.
supplements.summary: Taurine effectively reduced precancerous changes in stomach tissue, offering a potential preventive strategy for gastric cancer development.

supplements.title: Efficacy and safety of integrated Chinese and Western medicine in advanced pancreatic cancer: A double-center retrospective cohort study.
supplements.summary: In advanced pancreatic cancer, combining Chinese and Western medicine showed potential benefits, potentially improving patient outcomes compared to traditional treatment alone.

supplements.title: Clinical efficacy of Fuzheng Jiedu Xiaoyong granules in advanced colorectal cancer (spleen deficiency and stasis toxin syndrome).
supplements.summary: Fuzheng Jiedu Xiaoyong granules improved immune function and reduced side effects in patients with advanced colorectal cancer undergoing chemotherapy.

supplements.title: Mithramycin alters EWS::FLI1 DNA binding and RNA polymerase II processivity to inhibit nascent transcription.
supplements.summary: Mithramycin disrupts the EWS::FLI1 oncogene's DNA binding and RNA polymerase activity, inhibiting transcription and reducing Ewing sarcoma tumor growth.

supplements.title: A new (+)-curcuphenol derivative from the Indonesian marine sponge Myrmekioderma sp.: dual cytotoxic apoptotic and antiviral activities against A549, HeLa, and DENV-2.
supplements.summary: A new marine sponge-derived compound showed promising dual-action potential by killing lung and cervical cancer cells and inhibiting dengue virus.

supplements.title: Integrative Oncology for Biochemical Recurrence of Epithelial Ovarian Cancer.
supplements.summary: In women with early ovarian cancer recurrence, integrative oncology approaches may offer supportive care without using toxic treatments that do not improve survival.

supplements.title: Effectiveness and safety of bone protective interventions to mitigate bone loss and skeletal fractures experienced by patients with non-metastatic breast cancer: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
supplements.summary: Bisphosphonates effectively protect bone density and reduce fracture risk in non-metastatic breast cancer patients, with significant improvements in bone mineral density and skeletal health.

supplements.title: Iron-based nanomaterials for tumor therapy: structural engineering and functional mechanisms.
supplements.summary: Iron-based nanomaterials show promise in cancer treatment by generating reactive oxygen species, inducing cell death, and improving therapeutic targeting across multiple cancer types.

supplements.title: Neuroprotective potential of a plant-based intervention in diabetic neuropathy: Biochemical and behavioral insights from a streptozotocin-induced rat model.
supplements.summary: Plant-based treatment showed promise in reducing nerve damage in diabetic neuropathy by lowering oxidative stress and inflammation in a rat study.

supplements.title: Coordination Self-Assembly of a Carrier-Free Hyaluronic Acid-Modified Nanoplatform for Augmented Photothermal/Chemodynamic Therapy and Robust Antimetastatic Immunity.
supplements.summary: A carrier-free nanoplatform using luteolin and iron modifies hyaluronic acid to enhance cancer therapy by simultaneously destroying tumor cells and boosting immune response.

supplements.title: Pharmacological activation of GPX4 by selenomethionine attenuates cisplatin-induced ototoxicity and hearing loss.
supplements.summary: Selenomethionine protects against hearing loss caused by cisplatin chemotherapy by activating an enzyme that reduces cell damage in inner ear cells.

supplements.title: Lyophilization of Curcumin-Loaded Lipodisks; pre- and post-processing evaluation of formulation characteristics.
supplements.summary: Lyophilization with trehalose helps preserve curcumin-loaded lipid nanoparticles, maintaining drug stability and potentially improving anti-cancer drug delivery.

off_label.title: Insulin Autoimmune Syndrome Associated With Hashimoto Thyroiditis and Nodular Thyroid Disease: Clinical Management With Flash Glucose Monitoring and Prednisolone Therapy.
off_label.summary: In a rare case, prednisolone therapy successfully managed a white woman's insulin autoimmune syndrome associated with Hashimoto's thyroiditis and hypoglycemia.

off_label.title: Hyperactivation of mTORC1 signaling mediates folliculin deficiency-induced pulmonary cyst formation in Birt-Hogg-Dubé syndrome.
off_label.summary: In Birt-Hogg-Dubé syndrome, loss of the FLCN gene in lung mesenchymal cells leads to lung cyst formation through hyperactive mTORC1 signaling.

off_label.title: Cancer-Associated Fibroblasts Promote Imatinib Resistance in Gastrointestinal Stromal Tumors through PGK1-Mediated Metabolic Reprogramming.
off_label.summary: Cancer-associated fibroblasts in gastrointestinal stromal tumors promote imatinib resistance by altering cancer cell metabolism through TGFβ1 signaling.

off_label.title: Metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease and type 2 diabetes: Pathophysiology, diagnosis, and emerging therapeutic strategies.
off_label.summary: In patients with type 2 diabetes, emerging pharmacotherapies like GLP-1 receptor agonists show promise in treating metabolic liver disease and reducing related health risks.

off_label.title: Metallic elements and their molecular roles in gastric cancer: Pathogenic mechanisms and therapeutic implications.
off_label.summary: Metallic elements like iron, copper, zinc, and calcium play critical roles in gastric cancer progression through complex molecular mechanisms that influence tumor development and potential treatment strategies.

off_label.title: Exposure to GLP-1RA and risk of structural progression in differentiated thyroid cancer.
off_label.summary: GLP-1 receptor agonists may potentially slow structural progression in patients with well-differentiated thyroid cancer, suggesting a promising new therapeutic approach.

off_label.title: Digoxin attenuates LPS-induced acute lung injury in mice via NF-κB and HIF-1α inhibition.
off_label.summary: Digoxin effectively reduces lung inflammation and injury in mice by inhibiting key inflammatory pathways after lipopolysaccharide-induced acute lung damage.

off_label.title: Mitochondrial oxidants promote platelet activation and thrombotic susceptibility in prediabetes.
off_label.summary: In prediabetes, mitochondrial oxidants increase platelet activation and thrombosis risk, which can be reduced by targeted antioxidant treatments.

off_label.title: Targeting of HSP27 and MMP-2/9 Crosstalk by High-Throughput Drug Repurposing Strategies Identifies Paroxetine as a Potential Candidate in Glioblastoma.
off_label.summary: Paroxetine, an antidepressant, was found to inhibit HSP27 and reduce tumor progression in glioblastoma by disrupting key molecular interactions.

off_label.title: HSP90AB1-Mediated Ubiquitin-Proteasome Degradation of ITGBL1 Promotes Osteosarcoma Progression by Inhibiting Endoplasmic Reticulum Stress-Induced Autophagy.
off_label.summary: In osteosarcoma, HSP90AB1 promotes cancer progression by degrading ITGBL1, a protein that suppresses tumor growth, with ivermectin showing potential as a treatment.

off_label.title: cRGD-Functionalized macrophage extracellular vesicles loaded with GSK2033 enhance T cell antitumor immunity in GBM by disrupting the LXR/ABCA1-Mediated Myelin lipid transfer axis.
off_label.summary: cRGD-functionalized macrophage extracellular vesicles loaded with GSK2033 enhance T cell immunity by disrupting lipid transfer in glioblastoma, improving tumor treatment.

off_label.title: A dual-responsive metal-polyphenol nanomedicine based on targeting LAT1 via levodopa and ROS amplification for precise treatment of breast cancer.
off_label.summary: A metal-polyphenol nanoparticle targets triple-negative breast cancer cells, delivering chemotherapy and amplifying cell-killing reactive oxygen species.

off_label.title: The anti-obesity effect of namodenoson, an A3 adenosine receptor agonist.
off_label.summary: Namodenoson, an A3 adenosine receptor agonist, significantly reduced weight gain in obese mice by inhibiting adipocyte proliferation and lipid accumulation.

off_label.title: Lactate targeting: Regulatory networks and therapeutic potential in bone diseases.
off_label.summary: Lactate plays a multifaceted role in bone diseases by regulating immune responses, metabolism, and cellular processes across various bone-related pathological conditions.

off_label.title: Ameliorative effects of gum Arabic-coated selenium nanoparticles on Cisplatin-induced cerebellar neurotoxicity in rats.
off_label.summary: Selenium nanoparticles coated with Arabic gum successfully reduced neurotoxic damage in rat cerebellum caused by cisplatin chemotherapy treatment.

biomarkers.title: Novel bacterium Enterocloster sp. M3 promotes colorectal tumorigenesis via the production of the carcinogen styrene.
biomarkers.summary: The bacterial marker 'm3' shows promise for the non-invasive diagnosis of colorectal cancer (CRC) and adenomas.

biomarkers.title: Palladium-catalysed synthesis of small-molecule epigenetic inhibitors as anticancer therapeutics.
biomarkers.summary: Palladium-catalyzed chemical reactions enable precise synthesis of small-molecule compounds that could potentially inhibit cancer cell growth by targeting epigenetic mechanisms.

biomarkers.title: Design, synthesis and anti-breast cancer activity evaluation of 6,7-dihydro-5H-pyrrolo[3,4-d]pyrimidine-based PARP1/ATR dual inhibitors.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers developed a novel dual-targeting compound (38a) that effectively inhibits PARP1 and ATR, showing promising anti-breast cancer activity in triple-negative breast cancer cell lines.

biomarkers.title: Diethyl Phthalate (DEP) as a potential osteosarcoma risk factor: a multi-omics study integrating network Toxicology, single-cell RNA sequencing, and molecular docking.
biomarkers.summary: DEP, a common plasticiser, may increase osteosarcoma risk by disrupting extracellular matrix genes, potentially providing new diagnostic biomarkers.

biomarkers.title: Profound alterations of cancer transcriptomes by the RNase L inhibitor ABCE1 through the modulation of UU/UA-dinucleotide rich transcript abundance.
biomarkers.summary: ABCE1 overexpression in colorectal cancer alters gene expression of cell cycle-related transcripts, surprisingly correlating with improved patient survival.

biomarkers.title: Prophylactic Mechanical Closure for Preventing Delayed Bleeding after Gastric Endoscopic Submucosal Dissection: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
biomarkers.summary: Mechanical closure after gastric endoscopic submucosal dissection significantly reduces the risk of delayed bleeding complications.

biomarkers.title: Heme Oxygenase-1 as a Predictor of Early Allograft Dysfunction in Liver Transplantation: A Prospective Observational Pilot Study.
biomarkers.summary: In liver transplantation, higher levels of the enzyme heme oxygenase-1 might help predict and potentially reduce early allograft dysfunction risk.

biomarkers.title: Surveillance Strategies in Follicular Non-Hodgkin's Lymphoma's Using Molecular and Genetic Markers Improve Cost-efficiencies Over Routine Imaging Studies.
biomarkers.summary: Molecular and genetic markers can help identify follicular lymphoma patients at high risk of relapse, enabling more targeted and cost-effective surveillance strategies.

biomarkers.title: Cancer incidence and mortality trends from 2007 to 2021 in Milan.
biomarkers.summary: In Milan, cancer incidence declined for males and stabilized for females from 2007-2021, with mortality decreasing in both sexes, despite COVID-19 diagnostic disruptions in 2020.

biomarkers.title: A systems approach identifies MERTK as a therapeutic vulnerability in ZFTA-RELA-driven ependymomas.
biomarkers.summary: In ZFTA-RELA-driven ependymomas, targeting MERTK reduces tumor growth by suppressing key pro-survival signaling pathways in this aggressive brain cancer subtype.

biomarkers.title: Spatiotemporal histogenesis of the developing human cerebellum reveals dynamic layering of Bergmann glia.
biomarkers.summary: Bergmann glial cells in the human cerebellum emerge earlier than previously thought, forming a unique layered structure that supports Purkinje cell migration during early development.

biomarkers.title: Ivosidenib treatment in IDH-mutant WHO grade 4 astrocytomas: illustrative case.
biomarkers.summary: Isocitrate dehydrogenase (IDH) is a commonly mutated gene in gliomas.

biomarkers.title: Discovery of Novel Heterotetracyclic DNA-Dependent Protein Kinase (DNA-PK) Inhibitors with Improved Oral Bioavailability and Potent Cancer Immunotherapy-Potentiating Activity.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers developed a novel DNA-PK inhibitor (D11) that shows promise in cancer treatment by enhancing drug effectiveness and immune response across multiple cancer cell lines.

biomarkers.title: B4GALNT4-Mediated Glycosylation of PDK1 Activates the PI3K-AKT Signaling Pathway to Promote Prostate Cancer Progression.
biomarkers.summary: B4GALNT4 glycosylation of PDK1 stabilizes the protein and activates PI3K-AKT signaling, promoting prostate cancer progression and metastasis.

biomarkers.title: Humanized and Charge-Optimized CSPG4-Specific CAR-T Cells show Enhanced Efficacy against Head and Neck Squamous Cell Carcinoma.
biomarkers.summary: Humanized CSPG4 CAR-T cells targeting head and neck cancer show enhanced anti-tumor effectiveness by improving T cell metabolism and persistence.

trials.summary: Palladium-catalyzed chemical reactions enable precise synthesis of small-molecule compounds that could potentially inhibit cancer cell growth by targeting epigenetic mechanisms.

trials.title: PDZK1-ULK1 Axis Triggers Lipophagy to Inhibit Tumor Progression and Sunitinib Resistance in Clear Cell Renal Cell Carcinoma.
trials.summary: PDZK1 inhibits lipid droplet accumulation in kidney cancer by activating ULK1, potentially improving sunitinib treatment response.

trials.title: Up-to-date prevalence at recommended ages for discontinuing routine colorectal, cervical and lung cancer screening.
trials.summary: Up-to-date cancer screening rates varied widely, with colorectal screening highest (84.4%), cervical moderate (58.9%), and lung cancer screening very low (6.3%).
